title: Training Questions and Answers: Reserve Share for Move-Out Charges Not Yet Itemized
content:
# Reserve Share for Move-Out Charges Not Yet Itemized — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** In working out a move-out utility payment on a Utility Services Program account, the reserve share for move-out charges not yet itemized is set by the resident's tenure, because finishes past their useful life are never charged:

- **0.60** when the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 36 whole months before the service end date;
- **0.80** when it lies at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before it;
- **1.0** otherwise.

## Questions answered

**Tenure counted to which date?** To the service end date of the utility account, in whole months from the lease's move-in date.

**Move-in exactly 36 whole months before the service end date?** At least 36: 0.60.

**Move-in 11 whole months before?** Fewer than 12: 1.0.

## Bands

| Whole months from move-in to service end | Reserve share |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0.60 |
| 12 to 35 | 0.80 |
| fewer than 12 | 1.0 |

*Worked case (hypothetical cash deposit held of $1,500.00 with nothing itemized):* at 0.80 the reserve is $1,200.00; at 0.60, $900.00.
